headline: TotalEnergies Finds More Oil In Angola
summary: TotalEnergies discovers oil at Angola's Acacia-5 block with fast-track production plans. TTE stock outperforms as exploration expands.

headline: What's Going on With Exxon Mobil Shares on Thursday?
summary: ExxonMobil shares trade lower as Pioneer Natural Resources launches cash tender offers for $2.1 billion of outstanding senior notes due in 2030 and 2031.
